preconditions.description: The initial number of cards on the table is between 2 and 100.
The final number on the card is between -10000 and 10000.
The maximum value of the initial integers is between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (len(output.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= l for x in output.split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a list of n integers each between 1 and l, separated by spaces.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or sum((int(x) for x in output.split())) % d == 0
postconditions.description: The sum of the initial numbers is a multiple of d.
